title: Frontend Scaffolding Input
description: Input parameters for scaffolding a frontend webapp component with API client generation and configuration.

contracts.description: Contract names this webapp consumes (drives API client generation and config)

items.description: Contract name consumed by this webapp

contract_package.description: Workspace package name for API contract types (e.g., @my-project/api-types)

config_package.description: Workspace package name for webapp configuration types (e.g., @my-project/config)
